name: Kazuki Shou
source:
[i]"If you prove useful, I’ll even look for a way for you to get back home. Now, just come along."[/i]

Someone who's accompanying you during your stay in the village. He often acts blunt and aloof, but he's a very serious young man. However, he keeps a certain distance from you as if there is a side of him that he doesn't want you to see.

[Translated from [url=https://hyakunie.com/character/sho-kazuki/]official website[/url]]
